messages.body_plain:

Thanks a lot for the bug report and sorry for the late reply.
I'm still on Christmas vacation and will check that out next week.

messages.body_plain:
Hi Nilesh,

Thanks again for the bug report.

These tests must be ignored on i386 as the seed leads to different random numbers in our function on i386.
We released rpact 3.2.1 last week and in this version these tests on i386 will be automatically ignored.

Best,
Friedrich

  Friedrich Pahlke, Ph.D.
  RPACT
